title: [review] message.rs:562: RplTarget::write_to missing pr
description: write_to does not validate that self.prefix_len <= 128 before calculating nbytes. If an RplTarget is directly constructed with prefix_len > 128 (e.g., 200), then nbytes = 25 and line 574 will panic with slice index out of bounds when accessing self.prefix[..nbytes] (prefix is only [u8; 16]). The from_bytes path validates this (line 550), but direct struct construction bypasses that check.
